subject: Post-call: cost targets, volume bands & competitive snapshot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: volumes, target $/1M & comps

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and clear next steps so your team can align with procurement: 

Highlights from our discovery
- Primary workload: multi-turn customer support + summarization for transaction logs.
- Expected steady-state volume: ~150M tokens/month with peak months up to ~300M.
- Latency target: 200–350ms p99 for single-turn autocomplete flows; conversational flows can accept up to 700ms.
- Data needs: PCI-adjacent PII redaction, SOC2 evidence, VPC option for staging.

Cost / pricing expectations you mentioned
- Goal: keep unit cost low enough to support a SaaS margin target — you quoted an internal target of ~$5–8 per 1M tokens depending on workload.
- Budget range provided by your PM: $20k–$50k/month initially.

Competitive snapshot (high level) — context for benchmarking
- OpenAI-hosted tiers: widely used, strong quality but typically at the higher end of unit spend for the best models.
- Anthropic/other managed hosts: similar to OpenAI for production-grade models; some competitive offers at scale.
- Open-model hosting options: lower unit prices at high commits but variable latency/SLA.

What I’ll send you by EOD Monday
1) Short PDF with a $/1M token comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and typical open-host price bands (attached).
2) A proposed pricing band that maps to the volumes you indicated (hosted vs dedicated commit options).
3) Sample SLA + procurement checklist for a pilot (VPC options, SSO, invoicing).

Next steps
- Alex: confirm whether 150M or 300M is the right planning baseline for procurement (we can model both).
- Procurement: if you can share payment terms and preferred PO process, I’ll include that in the proposal.
- We’ll aim for a 30–60 day pilot with an option to convert to a reserved pool if volume hits the higher band.

Attachments: redwood-1M-rate-comps-20270418.pdf (summary) — full spreadsheet to follow.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0179
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: volumes, target $/1M & comps

Thanks Sean — useful recap. A few quick clarifications before procurement gets involved: 

1) Commit breakpoints — can you confirm if you have a defined price break at ~500M tokens/month? Our CFO wants a concrete number for that tier.
2) SLA/latency — can you share the p99 latency guarantee for hosted vs dedicated? We need to confirm we won’t regress performance during peak.
3) Pilot details — we’d like to run the pilot in our us-west region and evaluate for 30 days with the option to scale. Any constraints on pilot quantity?

I’ll loop in procurement once we see the formal bands. Also copying procurement in my next reply.

Regards,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering
Finexa
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finexa.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: volumes, target $/1M & comps

Alex/Procurement — attaching the summary PDF and the pricing bands spreadsheet. Key points below so procurement can quickly model spend.

Attached: redwood-1M-rate-comps-20270418.pdf, finexa-proposal-pricing-bands.xlsx

Pricing bands (hosted API / monthly billing) — example bands we recommend for the pilot and scale modeling:
- 0–100M tokens/mo: $9.00 per 1M tokens (no commit)
- 100–500M tokens/mo: $6.50 per 1M tokens (volume discounts applied monthly)
- 500M+ tokens/mo: custom committed pricing (typically $4.80–$5.50 per 1M depending on term and model family)

Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit, better unit economics and SLOs):
- 250M commit: $5.50 per 1M effective (includes 99.9% uptime SLA and dedicated GPU capacity)
- 500M+ commit: $4.25–$4.75 per 1M effective (longer terms improve rates)

Competitive comparison (brief) — per-1M effective rates (illustrative):
- OpenAI (managed): higher-end for best-in-class models — typical production-rate bands above $10/1M for advanced models.
- Anthropic (managed): similar to OpenAI in top-tier quality and unit cost.
- Open-model hosts: can be below $6/1M at high commit levels but vary on latency/SLO and model parity.

Pilot recommendation
- Run a 30-day pilot at the 150M baseline (we can cap at 200M for the trial) with hosted billing at the 100–500M band effective rate so you have a realistic sample of unit economics.
- If you sign a 6–12 month commit after pilot, we can move you onto a dedicated reserved pool with the lower committed tiers above.

SLA & security
- Hosted: 99.5% uptime guarantee, p99 latency targets dependent on model; we’ll include measured p99 for the model we propose.
- Dedicated: 99.9% uptime, regional placement (us-west) and VPC peering for staging; SOC2 evidence available.

Docs/links
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FINEXA-2027-042
- Proposal & pricing spreadsheet in Drive (link above)
- DocuSign link for standard order form: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DEMO-FINEXA-QUOTE

Next asks from procurement
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly/quarterly), PO template, and standard payment terms (Net30/Net45).
- If procurement confirms a target commit (e.g., 250M), I’ll prepare a committed quote and the reserved pool sizing.

I’ll follow up with Rishi (cc’d) to provide the detailed SLA and the empirical p99 numbers from our us-west endpoints for the exact model family we’d recommend.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0179
From: Procurement Team <procurement@finexa.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: volumes, target $/1M & comps

Sean — thanks for the clear bands and doc bundle. A few procurement items so we can move quickly: 

1) Our initial operational budget allows ~$30k/month for the pilot. Can you confirm the expected spend at the 150M baseline under the 100–500M band? (we prefer a simple monthly estimate we can plug into our finance model).
2) PO & invoicing: please send your standard PO template and indicate whether Net30 is acceptable.
3) Pilot constraints: we'll start with the us-west region as requested; please confirm there are no hidden per-region charges.

If Pilots look good and spend aligns, we can approve a 6-month reserved commit conversation.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Finexa
procurement@finexa.com
